verdict.rationale: GoDaddy documents an Auctions API for acquiring expiring domains, through open bidding or fixed-price Buy Now closeouts, which gives an aftermarket path for some taken names. Search and quoting are documented, but nothing shows premium pricing surfaced in search results, and nothing covers a broker or marketplace route for actively held names. missing for 10: premium-price flagging in search/availability results, a broker or marketplace listing path for registered (non-expiring) domains, independent or hands-on corroboration.
